title: Tail-Aware Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective paradigm for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student is trained to align its next-token distribution with the teacher's along its own trajectories. To provide dense supervision at tractable cost, many works minimize the reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the student and teacher's normalized distributions over the teacher's top-$k$ tokens. However, this normalized objective discards the information about tail probability: the total probability outside the teacher's top-$k$ tokens. As a result, the optimization can steadily increase the student's tail probability and entropy, empirically degrading downstream accuracy. To address this issue, we propose Tail-Aware Top-$k$ OPD (\textbf{TA-OPD}), a novel distillation method that restores the missing tail probability signal. translated_title: 尾部感知的Top-$k$在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14728v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为语言模型间知识迁移的有效范式，其中学生模型沿其自身轨迹训练，使其下一个词元分布与教师模型对齐。为了以可承受的成本提供密集监督，许多工作最小化学生和教师分布在教师前$k$个词元上的归一化反向库尔贝克-莱布勒（KL）散度。然而，这种归一化目标丢弃了关于尾部概率的信息：即教师前$k$个词元之外的总概率。因此，优化过程可能持续增加学生模型的尾部概率和熵，经验上这会降低下游任务准确性。为解决此问题，我们提出尾部感知的Top-$k$在线策略蒸馏（**TA-OPD**），一种新颖的蒸馏方法，恢复了缺失的尾部概率信号。具体来说，TA-OPD最小化前$k$个词元上的反向KL散度。
tldr: 提出TA-OPD方法，通过恢复在线策略蒸馏中忽略的尾部概率信号，防止学生模型熵增，从而提升下游任务性能。
en_tdlr: TA-OPD restores the ignored tail probability signal in on-policy distillation, preventing entropy increase in the student model and improving downstream performance.
